{"edits":[{"find":"    always@(*) begin
        if(~rst) begin
            {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;","replace":"    always@(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if(~rst) begin
            {out1, out2, out3} <= 3'b000;"},{"find":"                S0, S0_5, S1: {out1, out2, out3} = 0;","replace":"                S0, S0_5, S1: {out1, out2, out3} <= 0;"},{"find":"                S1_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b100: 3'b000;","replace":"                S1_5        : {out1, out2, out3} <= ~sel? 3'b100: 3'b000;"},{"find":"                S2          : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b000;","replace":"                S2          : {out1, out2, out3} <= ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b000;"},{"find":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;","replace":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} <= ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;"},{"find":"                S3          : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b011;","replace":"                S3          : {out1, out2, out3} <= ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b011;"},{"find":"                default     : {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;","replace":"                default     : {out1, out2, out3} <= 3'b000;"}],"violated_requirement":"Dispensing outputs must be combinational from the current state and selection; making them registered delays out1/out2/out3 by one clock edge relative to the accumulated amount.","spec_basis":"Beverage dispensing outputs out1/out2/out3 reflect the current accumulated amount and beverage selection."}

{"edits":[{"find":"    always@(*) begin
        if(~rst) begin
            {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;
        end
        else begin
            case(state)","replace":"    always@(*) begin
        if(~rst) begin
            {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;
        end
        else begin
            case(nstate)"}],"violated_requirement":"Outputs must reflect the current state and selection, not the next state.","spec_basis":"out1/out2/out3 dispense based on accumulated money and selection; the machine accumulates and dispenses based on current state."}

{"edits":[{"find":"            default: nstate = S0;","replace":"            default: nstate = state;"}],"violated_requirement":"The FSM must not hold in the 2.5-yuan/3-yuan states; those states must advance (return to the initial state) so later currency insertions are accumulated and beverages/change are dispensed correctly.","spec_basis":"Currency input behavior: 'The machine accumulates the total amount of money inserted'; Beverage dispensing: out1/out2/out3 dispense beverage 1 (1.5 yuan), beverage 2 (2.5 yuan) and 0.5-yuan change."}

{"edits":[{"find":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;","replace":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b100: 3'b010;"}],"violated_requirement":"When 2.5 yuan has been inserted and beverage 1 (1.5 yuan, sel=0) is selected, the machine must also dispense 0.5 yuan change (out3=1).","spec_basis":"out3: Dispenses change (0.5 yuan coins only); Change dispensing: Only 0.5 yuan coins are dispensed as change."}

{"edits":[{"find":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;","replace":"                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b011;"}],"violated_requirement":"When exactly 2.5 yuan has accumulated and beverage 2 is selected (sel=1), the machine must dispense beverage 2 alone (out2=1, out3=0); the mutant also asserts out3, giving spurious 0.5-yuan change.","spec_basis":"out3: Dispenses change (0.5 yuan coins only); Beverage 2 costs 2.5 yuan (no change is due on an exact payment)."}
